name: Prior-Conditioned Parameterization (I)
definition: An initialization method that seeds anisotropic Gaussians by estimating local surface statistics (normals and scales) from a dense prior P, front-loading structure discovery.
summary: Prior-Conditioned Parameterization (I) initializes anisotropic Gaussians by estimating local surface statistics from a dense prior, setting it apart by explicitly constructing disc-like covariance structures aligned to estimated normals.
